steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test.
Apply the company setting whose effect on Price Components is being tested.
Apply the additional configuration specified by the case.
Give the draft a known title so it can be reopened from Drafts.
Apply a pricing template required for a valid eRFX draft.
Add the draft's required line item.
Complete the pricing sheet so the draft can be saved.
Commit a schedule for the saved draft.
Create the saved, unpublished eRFX draft under test.
Navigate to the events list to follow the requested Drafts flow.
Confirm the newly saved draft is present in Drafts.
Reopen the saved draft's create screen.
Assert that Price Components is not offered on the saved eRFX draft.
